## Scope

Describe the model, runtime, hardware, and layout being proposed.

## Provenance

Include pinned sources, revisions, licenses or terms notes, and whether any observations are synthetic or measured.

## Fixture

Describe the hand calculation or observation that should become a regression test.

## Data Hygiene

Confirm that this issue does not include model weights, credentials, private workloads, copied provider pages, or benchmark datasets.
